students.title: Class List
students.item1: Create as many classes as you like in the class manager and switch between them – each class keeps its own students, seating plans and classrooms.
students.item2: Add students one by one, create placeholders for a whole class, or import a CSV file – "What the file has to look like" shows the required structure.
students.item3: Select up to 3 preferred and distance partners per student – the order determines priority.
students.item4: Search, filter and sorting help you find individual students; the checkboxes let you edit several students at once.
students.item5: Add photos via the portrait icon – they stay on this device only and unlock the name game.
students.item6: Take back changes to the class list with the arrow buttons or Ctrl/Cmd+Z; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z restores them.
students.item7: Toggle the labels under the buttons in the student list.

layout.title: Classroom
layout.item1: Choose a template or add tables by clicking.
layout.item2: Move and rotate tables via drag & drop.
layout.item3: Multi-select: Shift or Ctrl/Cmd + click, or draw a selection rectangle.
layout.item4: Right-click (desktop) or long press (touch) opens the context menu.
layout.item5: Save custom classroom templates via the sidebar.
layout.item6: Drag room elements such as windows, door, desk, blackboard, whiteboard, cabinet or divider from the sidebar into the room.
layout.item7: Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes steps in the classroom, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z redoes them.

plan.title: Seating Plan
plan.item1: Adjust the weighting of criteria (0-10) in the sidebar.
plan.item2: Drag students to other seats via drag & drop.
plan.item3: Click the lock icon to lock a seat for the next shuffle.
plan.item4: Statistics badges show how well criteria are met.
plan.item5: "Optimize" improves the current plan further without shuffling it from scratch.
plan.item6: The view settings control how names appear (first name only, first name + initial, or full name) and whether photos are shown.
plan.item7: Ctrl/Cmd+Z takes back shuffles and moves, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z restores them.

circle.title: Seating Circle
circle.item1: Drag students to new positions via drag & drop.
circle.item2: Green lines show connections to table neighbors in the seating plan.
circle.item3: Toggle connections in the sidebar or with key C.
circle.item4: The circle stays linked to the seating plan but can be saved and exported separately.

export.title: Export
export.item1: Customize the name of your seating plan.
export.item2: Switch between portrait and landscape format for PDF export.
export.itemFlip: Set the viewing direction under page format: "From the back" rotates the room by 180° for a desk at the back, while names and photos stay readable.
export.item3: Use the sidebar to decide what is shown: room elements, needs, photos, legend and additional class info.
export.itemNames: Choose how names appear: first name only, first name + last name initial, or the full name.
export.item4: Toggle preview between Seating Plan and Seating Circle (top right).
export.item5: Besides PDF and print you can save the view as a PNG image or an SVG vector graphic — handy for parent letters or the school portal.

present.title: Presentation mode
present.item1: Switch between teacher and student view as well as between seating plan and circle at the top.
present.item2: The student view shows the plan from the class's perspective – without markers and photos.
present.item3: Show or hide markers, photos, colors and room elements using the bar at the bottom.
present.itemNames: "Names" cycles between first name, first name + last name initial, and the full name.
present.item4: Zoom with the slider or mouse wheel and drag to pan; the centre icon resets the view.
present.item5: Press Alt + ← to return to the generator.
present.item6: "Who's next?" draws a random student and spotlights their seat – everyone gets a turn before anyone repeats.
present.item7: Keyboard: F fullscreen, Space draws a student, Esc resets the draw, + / − zoom, 0 recenters.
